Final FLT3 call plot previews

Fragment recheck report

Main histograms use actual trimmed lengths of reads that pass final competitive validation and support the displayed reported allele. The full panel includes WT; the zoom contains reported ITD reads only. The second plot shows actual trimmed read length minus the 336 bp WT reference, not extracted insertion events. Dotted markers show exact called insertion sizes (or WT reference plus those sizes in the full plot). Trimming and sequencing indels can shift observed histogram peaks away from exact called sizes.

These previews reuse saved final competitive validation and retained FASTQ lengths matched by read ID. No GMM fitting, denoising or read alignment was repeated. No earlier GMM cluster assignments supply the main histogram counts. The two 45 bp sequences differ at one junction base; separate biological clones are not established. The 0.1% preview includes both alternatives; the 0.5% preview applies the original review reporting threshold. The caller default remains 5%.
